cond_0001.intro: The RF Hardware team is responsible for wireless hardware development for silicon platforms and products. We are looking for a talented individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands-on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

A regular part of this role involves staying in contact with design engineers, rework technicians, and test automation engineers to keep work moving.
cond_0042.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Stay in touch with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and share it directly with design engineers for review. Work closely with design engineers on data processing and visualization, and be ready to walk them through findings and handle questions.
Collaborate daily with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Connect regularly with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0042.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3–5 years of hands-on RF test and measurement experience.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — you will be in regular contact with engineers and technicians.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of RF measurement and characterization work.
cond_0067.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0067.requirements:
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Scripting and script debug experience is a plus (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools is a plus (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

We are looking for an individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with RF test and measurement work.
cond_0113.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0113.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands-on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

Scripting and script debug experience is a plus (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools is a plus (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

We are looking for a talented individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp RF measurement concepts and the logic behind hardware characterization work.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0220.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

cond_0300.intro: The RF Hardware team is responsible for wireless hardware development for silicon platforms and products. We are looking for a talented individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line.
cond_0300.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0300.requirements:
An Associate's degree or higher in electronics, or around 3–5 years of hands-on RF test and measurement experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience working with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, and DC power supplies.
Experience running characterization efforts on RF components or systems using automated test setups.
Scripting and script debug experience is a plus (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Familiarity with data analysis tools is a plus (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Some exposure to reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts is a plus.
Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally.
Ability to stay organized and manage priorities effectively.

cond_0362.intro: The RF Hardware team is responsible for wireless hardware development for silicon platforms and products. We are looking for a talented individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line.
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Work with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Collect measurement data from the test stations and provide it to design engineers for review. Assist design engineers with data processing and visualization.
Collaborate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues, and to ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree or higher in electronics required; advanced degree strongly preferred — or minimum 5 years of demonstrated hands-on expertise in RF test and measurement.
Deep knowledge of RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Proven expertise with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, and DC power supplies.
Substantial experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in scripting and script debugging (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Strong command of data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Solid understanding of reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

cond_0404.intro: The RF Hardware team is responsible for wireless hardware development for silicon platforms and products. We are looking for an individual to join our team to measure and characterize cellular radio hardware designs across our entire product line.
cond_0404.responsibilities:
Build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times. Lead coordination with lab management on test equipment maintenance.
Execute test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Deliver measurement data from the test stations to design engineers for review. Drive data processing and visualization efforts with design engineers.
Direct collaboration with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Lead debugging of test script/station issues with test automation engineers, and ensure rack equipment and test software is up to date.
cond_0404.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands-on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.

cond_0468.responsibilities:
Work with lab management to build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Help ensure test setups are fully calibrated and running at maximum efficiency at all times.
Coordinate with design engineers to run test setup automation tools, collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs, and support data processing and visualization.
Work alongside rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Collaborate with test automation engineers to debug test script/station issues and help keep rack equipment and test software up to date.
cond_0468.requirements:
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3-5 years of experience in hands on RF test and measurement.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Scripting and script debug experience is a plus (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools is a plus (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.

Work with the team to build out rack-based RF test setups capable of running fully automated hardware characterization test campaigns. Coordinate with lab management on test equipment maintenance to keep setups calibrated and running efficiently.
Run test setup automation tools to collect parametric data on cellular hardware designs. Share measurement data from test stations with design engineers for review, and assist them with data processing and visualization.
Coordinate with rework technicians to have hardware reworked with new component revisions for characterization. Work alongside test automation engineers to debug test script and station issues, and to keep rack equipment and test software up to date.
cond_0621.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associates degree or higher in electronics, or 3–5 years of hands-on RF test and measurement experience.
Experience in RF test and measurement methodology and equipment in the 600MHz to 6GHz frequency range.
Experience with spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, cellular call boxes, load pull tuners, oscilloscopes, and DC power supplies.
Experience running long characterization efforts on RF components or systems using fully automated test setups.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Scripting and script debug experience (Python, Matlab, etc.).
Experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Excel, Matlab, etc.).
Basic familiarity with reading schematics and reviewing PCB layouts.
cond_0621.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
